instruction: On the command line, mirror the image horizontally (flip left to right) and save as "mirrored.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires horizontally flipping the image (mirror left-right). The evaluator checks if the result is the horizontal mirror of the source by comparing SSIM after flipping. Verified by generating expected output with PIL's FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT transpose.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal mirror operation on the image
Correct getter logic: get_vm_file fetches result from VM, get_rule returns source path
Correct metric logic: Loads source image, applies FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT transformation, compares with result using SSIM (threshold=0.95)
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('source_path') - expected IS the rules dict for type='rule'
Semantic correctness: Expected value points to correct source image path
Robust implementation: Handles None values, exceptions, image size/shape mismatches
Practical feasibility: Can extract result file, perform comparison, and verify horizontal flip operation
